topics.label: Babies & Toddlers
topics.description: Expecting, newborns, infants, and toddlers from 0 to 3 years, covering feeding, sleep, firsts, and early parenting; not for school-age or teen issues.

topics.label: Films, TV & Anime
topics.description: Movies, television, and anime, including series and streaming debates; not text-only books, manga, or comics.

topics.label: Gaming & Video Games
topics.description: Video game discussions and community: current-generation and general game talk across PC/console, plus dedicated servers, LFG, dad streams, event votes, and gaming meetups; retro and tabletop have dedicated tags.

topics.label: Humor & Memes
topics.description: Dad jokes, memes, and playful internet humor, not serious advice or current-event discussions.

topics.label: Kids & Teens
topics.description: Parenting from early school age through teenagers, covering school, discipline, milestones, and teen issues; not infants, toddlers, or adult children.

topics.label: Local Connections
topics.description: Regional dad communities, location-based threads, and meetup discussions like NYC, UK, or Kentucky; not for subjects not tied to geography.

topics.label: Music
topics.description: What members are listening to: albums, artists, music leagues, recommendations, and music discussions; score production and audio editing not covered.

topics.label: Parenthood
topics.description: General parenting talk and advice that spans ages and family situations, such as adopting, fostering, step-parenting, LGBTQ+ dadding, and multi-age households; specific child-stage and partner-only topics have their own tags.

topics.label: Relationships
topics.description: Partner, marriage, and co-parenting relationship discussions; not parent-to-child relationship or friendship talk.

topics.label: Retro Gaming
topics.description: Classic, older games, vintage consoles, emulation, and re-homed titles; not current-generation releases.

topics.label: Server News & Feedback
topics.description: Server welcome, rules, FAQ, wiki, announcements, suggestions, polls, and community feedback; not general game or parenting conversation.

topics.label: Tabletop Gaming
topics.description: Board games, TTRPGs, tabletop simulators, wargames, and coordinating looks-for-group sessions; not video game versions of those titles.

critique_notes: No tags were dropped; all 12 candidate slugs are kept.

Expanded gaming-community to include current-generation and general video game discussions (previously only community activities), since the sample contains many modern game channels and titles; retro and tabletop are explicitly separated.
Expanded films-and-tv to include anime (previously excluded), matching the anime channel; books/manga/comics remain uncovered.
Reworded kids-teens to start at early school age, reserving toddler for babies-and-toddlers, avoiding overlap.
Reworded parenthood to explicitly include family situations like adoption, fostering, step-parenting, and LGBTQ+ dadding.

Gaps the vocabulary cannot cover: general/off-topic chat (e.g., general channel, food talk, VTubers), books/literature/manga/comics (e.g., book-club, comics, One Piece manga), and lifestyle/hobby/career topics (e.g., workout, electronics repair, entrepreneurs). These do not have a consensus tag, so they remain uncovered.
